lines.beaver: 올해 소비 경향 보고서, 대강 설명해 주실래요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you roughly explain this year's consumer trend report?
lines.beaver_roman: Olhae sobi gyeonghyang bogoseo, daegang seolmyeonghae jusillaeyo?
lines.learner: 요즘 손님들은 제값 주고 사지 않는 경향을 보여요.
lines.en: These days, customers tend not to pay full price.
lines.roman: Yojeum sonnimdeureun jegap jugo saji anneun gyeonghyangeul boyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: So do they look for discounted products a lot?
lines.learner: 네, 상품권으로 사는 사람도 많이 늘었어요.
lines.en: Yes, and many more people buy with gift certificates.
lines.roman: Ne, sangpumgwoneuro saneun saramdo mani neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do free gifts have an effect?
lines.learner: 사은품이나 경품이 있으면 더 사는 경향을 보여요.
lines.en: People tend to buy more when there are free gifts or prizes.
lines.roman: Saeunpumina gyeongpumi isseumyeon deo saneun gyeonghyangeul boyeoyo.

lines.learner: 품목별로는 생활 물품이 제일 많이 팔렸어요.
lines.en: By item, household goods sold the most.
lines.roman: Pummokbyeolloneun saenghwal mulpumi jeil mani pallyeosseoyo.

lines.learner: 실은 대리점보다 온라인 주문이 더 많아요.
lines.en: Actually, there are more online orders than dealership sales.
lines.roman: Sireun daerijeomboda ollain jumuni deo manayo.

lines.beaver_en: How is luxury goods spending these days?
lines.learner: 명품은 사지 않고 대여하는 사람도 늘었어요.
lines.en: More people rent luxury goods instead of buying them.
lines.roman: Myeongpumeun saji anko daeyeohaneun saramdo neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: They even rent, huh. What about shipping?
lines.learner: 손님들은 무료 배송이 되는 가게를 애용해요.
lines.en: Customers favor stores that offer free shipping.
lines.roman: Sonnimdeureun muryo baesongi doeneun gagereul aeyonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Were there any problems with defective products?
lines.learner: 불량품은 무상으로 바꿔 줘서 불만이 적었어요.
lines.en: We replaced defective items for free, so complaints were few.
lines.roman: Bullyangpumeun musangeuro bakkwo jwoseo bulmani jeogeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How did you handle lost items in the store?
lines.learner: 습득한 물품은 모두 고객 센터에 맡겼어요.
lines.en: We left all found items at the customer center.
lines.roman: Seupdeukan mulpumeun modu gogaek sentere matgyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. I'll reflect this in the report.
lines.learner: 네, 연도별 자료도 정리해서 보내 드릴게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll organize the yearly data and send it too.
lines.roman: Ne, yeondobyeol jaryodo jeongnihaeseo bonae deurilgeyo.
